answer: Stake-weighted vouching resists Sybil attacks by requiring each new agent to obtain cryptographic endorsements from staked peers who lock collateral per recruit. Rather than letting bots sprout like yarrow across an open orchard, the protocol locks sponsor liquidity and slashes it upon misbehavior, imposing a verifiable capital cost per identity. Though onboarding moves like a glacier for unvetted newcomers, colluding insiders can still form closed cliques to endorse their own clones.
